about: USD per million tokens, by model family. Fitted by least squares to the Claude SDK's own per-session bills in this database (usd against fresh input, output, cache read and cache write), with the list ratios in:out:write held at 1:5:1.25 and cache read free. Sonnet: 984 sessions, median error $0.06 a session, billed $1821 against modelled $1824. Haiku: 157 sessions, median error $0.01, $71 against $70. A model with no family here has no price and its turns show as unpriced.
